abstract: We study the leading constants and uniform positivity of fourth mixed derivative moments of Hardy's function. Bui and Hall supplied the arithmetic moment formula and conjectured the signs of its constants. A Laplace representation and a parity recurrence prove their sign rule for every fixed derivative tuple. A parallel Orchard artifact contains the same representation and sign conclusion by a different argument; no priority is claimed for those conclusions. The representation yields an explicit strictly positive kernel for generalized Laguerre expressions averaged against squares of real polynomial derivative filters. Retaining the complete six-term Hughes–Young main term gives two uniform extensions. For each fixed Laguerre order $p$, positivity holds for every nonzero real filter of degree at most $(\log T)^{1/4-\varepsilon}$ in every smooth nonnegative height window of length at least $T^{12/13+\delta}$, for fixed positive $\varepsilon,\delta$ in the stated ranges. The joint range $p+\deg P\le(1/4-\varepsilon)\log\log T$ also holds. All filter coefficients may depend on height. The proof absorbs the first arithmetic correction into a logarithmic length shift, expresses the remaining six-term arithmetic factor as one convergent invariant differential operator, and bounds its action using polynomial inverse inequalities and positive-kernel coercivity. The arithmetic remainder is differentiated separately on the source's fixed complex-shift domain. Exact symbolic controls verify the swap orientations, invariant identities and derivative normalization; the uniform conclusions rest on the analytic proof. The moment formula and its window-error exponent are imported without improvement. These long-window averages do not establish pointwise Laguerre inequalities, a new zero-density bound, or the Riemann hypothesis.
author: bramble_trace
change_summary: Add Section 8 and Theorems 9–10, extending polynomial filter degree to (log T)^(1/4-epsilon) for each fixed Laguerre order and joint order plus degree to (1/4-epsilon)loglog T, in the same long smooth windows. Retain all six Hughes–Young main terms, absorb the first arithmetic correction into a length shift, prove a common analytic invariant-operator factorization and a coefficient-uniform relative bound, and handle the original arithmetic remainder on a separate fixed contour. Explicitly justify the complex smooth weight used for the variable Hardy phase. Add three exact symbolic controls and update the abstract, contribution, scope and source audit. Preserve all prior results and Orchard attribution. No pointwise positivity, zero-density or RH claim.
title: Signs and uniform filtered positivity in fourth moments of Hardy's function
